title: GenerationContextItem
description: One piece of material that was put in front of the model for a generation, and where it came from. Written down because the source can change afterwards: this says what was actually read, in the order it was read.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

generation.description: The generation this was given to, by its id in the system that holds it.

sourceType.description: What kind of thing the material came from. Free text: the kinds belong to whatever the retrieving system can reach.

sourceId.description: The id of that thing, in the system that owns it. Paired with sourceType, which says what kind of id it is.

content.description: The material as it was handed to the model. A copy on purpose — the source may be edited or deleted later, and this is what was read.

rank.description: Its place in the order the items were assembled in, counting from the first. Position, not score.

similarityScore.description: How close the retrieval judged it to the ask. Absent when the item was not chosen by similarity. The scale belongs to whichever retrieval produced it.
